adjudication_summary: Source re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 with cautions: current packet/final artifacts contain source-located antibacterial activity rows, source-reviewed APD6 database adjudication with one preserved conflict, and no unsupported toxicity or mechanism overclaim. The paper is publication-grade for obtainable local material, but cautions remain for Q22A S. hominis value disagreement, absent toxicity endpoints, APD6 free-text provenance, absent linked sequence snapshot, and a stale Table 1/2/3 request that does not match the XML.

materials_exhausted.note: All local material named in the handoff and packet was checked for the owner-layer blockers. No blocking material gap remains; absent toxicity endpoints are recorded as a caution, not fabricated.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 packet audit contains 12 APD6-linked audits: 11 source_verified and one source_conflict. Verified rows have sequence/citation locators; AP04772/Q22A keeps the S. hominis value conflict instead of converting it to source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 packet/final activity output contains 26 source-located rows from XML Fig. 1, Results/Methods, Supplementary Fig. 2/3/6, and Supplementary Table 4/source data. Core endpoint/value/unit/species/condition/locator fields are present. Local material reports no toxicity endpoint, recorded as a nonblocking caution.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism artifacts remain contextual and caution-limited; no direct mechanism claim is promoted beyond source-located fibril formation, bacterial co-localization/contact, and structure-guided activity interpretation.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The original rework ticket is resolved because its stated blockers are no longer true in current artifacts. The XML table request was partly stale: only XML Table 1 exists and it is crystallography, while activity evidence resides in figures/prose/supplement/source data.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 free text reports Q22A S. hominis MIC 50 µM, while main Results prose states 53 µM; final activity row preserves the Supplementary Fig. 3 value and records the main-text cross-check.
Local XML/PDF/supplement/database material supports antibacterial MIC/growth evidence but no mammalian cytotoxicity, hemolysis, HC50, CC50, or viability endpoint for this paper.

APD6 linked_experiment_records are entry-level free-text comments. Final activity values are therefore anchored to XML Fig. 1/Results and Supplementary Fig. 2/3/6 text rather than treated as database-only assay rows.

Packet has zero linked_sequence_records; source-verified APD6 rows use Supplementary Table 4/primary-source sequence locators and merged APD6 sequence-export agreement preserved in the database audit.

The handoff requested XML Table 1/2/3 reconciliation, but the source XML contains one table only, Table 1 data collection/refinement statistics; activity evidence is in Fig. 1, Results/Methods prose, Supplementary figures, and source-data spreadsheet text.
Mechanism records remain contextual/locator-backed and are not promoted to direct mechanism claims beyond the paper-supported fibril/bacterial-contact interpretation.
